title: Disputed review finding outcomes
description: The answers an adjudicator may give when the editor and a reviewer, or two reviewers, disagree about one finding in a content change review.

source.note: bean bvuk; owner approved the answer set 2026-09-23

codes.label: The finding stands
codes.definition: The finding is right; the author addresses it before the change can be approved.

codes.label: The finding is withdrawn
codes.definition: The finding is wrong; the review comment closes as adjudicated, with the decision that closed it.
